thread:
oncall-bot: Pager: P1 - Increased inference latency for embeddings in eu-west-1 affecting Dedicated and Hosted tiers. Alert: latency > 2s for 80% of requests. Assigning to oncall: maria.garcia. Incident ID: INC-2141

maria.garcia: I'm on it, pulling metrics now. Starting a Zoom for quick triage — joining in 2 mins.

sam.k: seeing similar errors from customer telemetry. Some retries succeed. ETA 10m for initial assessment.

jordan.l: FYI I rotated a GPU pool earlier but no config changes since. Will check routing/hotshard counts.

lee: quick check — redis cache hit rate for KV prefixes dropped from 92% -> 35% around 2141592500. Could explain load.

maria.garcia: good catch @lee. Rolling back the recent cache invalidation keyspace change on staging now to see effect. If that helps, we'll craft status copy.

ops-lead: priority here is customer-facing comms. Draft an initial status page message (short) + internal notes. I'll review. @statusbot prepare a placeholder on status page in Draft state.

statusbot: Status page placeholder created: "Investigating — Increased latency for embeddings in eu-west-1" (draft). Link: https://status.redwood.example/d/INC-2141

maria.garcia: rollback applied to a canary node, latency back to baseline on that node. Gradually rolling to remaining nodes.

nina.p: customers impacted list: two large PLG customers showing increased error rates, plus several smaller ones. No data loss observed.

sam.k: drafting initial status text below. Feedback welcome.

sam.k: ```
We are currently investigating increased latency for embeddings requests in eu-west-1. Customers may experience slower responses or occasional timeouts. Our engineering team is actively rolling a mitigation. We will provide updates as we learn more.
- Impact: Increased latency for embeddings in eu-west-1
- Services affected: Hosted API, Dedicated pools in eu-west-1
- Customer impact: Some requests may be slower or time out; no data loss identified
- Next update: in 20 minutes or when there is a material change
```

jordan.l: language looks fine. Suggest adding "workaround" line if we find a short-term routing preference (e.g., route to eu-central if acceptable).

ops-lead: add a note about estimated ETA for mitigation if we can. Otherwise keep it conservative. Also cc @legal and customer-support in draft.

maria.garcia: mitigation finished rollouts at 2141592800. Observability shows request p50/p95 back to normal. Continuing to monitor.

nina.p: pushing a customer-facing email template for Support to send to top-impacted customers.

nina.p: ```
Hi <Customer>,

We wanted to let you know we experienced elevated latency for embedding requests from our eu-west-1 region earlier today. Our engineers identified a cache invalidation issue that temporarily reduced cache hit rates and rolled a mitigation which restored normal service. You may have seen slower responses or retries during the window. No data was lost and we do not expect any downstream impacts.

If you continue to see problems please reply and we'll prioritize investigation for your account.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Support
```

sam.k: updating status page draft to include resolved note once monitoring shows stable. Proposed resolved copy: "Resolved — Service restored for embeddings in eu-west-1. Root cause: inadvertent cache invalidation triggered by recent keyspace change. Mitigation: rollback and hit-rate recovery. We’re implementing a safer rollout policy and holdback checks."

ops-lead: typo: change 'hit-rate' -> 'cache hit rate'. Also add link to post-incident review doc when available.

maria.garcia: will open PIR and add timeline. Drafting RCA now.

statusbot: Status page updated to "Monitoring" with text from @sam.k. Link: https://status.redwood.example/d/INC-2141/updates/1

jordan.l: confirm we should publish a 'resolved' update once 30m of steady metrics. We're at ~5m now. Recommend wait until 30m.

lee: agree. Also note to add a config gate to the rollout for the future. Will open PR for automated gate.

sam.k: publishing resolved update now as metrics have held for 32 minutes. Posting resolved copy: ```Resolved — We have restored normal latency for embeddings in eu-west-1 after rolling back a cache keyspace change that reduced cache hits. No data loss was observed. A post-incident review will be published with remediation steps.```

statusbot: Status page update published (Resolved). Public link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2141/resolved — published by sam.k at 2141592860 :thumbsup:

ops-lead: nice work team. Ask Support to send the customer follow-ups using @nina.p template and include link to the status page. I'll start PIR and loop in security/legal if needed.

maria.garcia: logging follow-ups in the incident tracker and tagging the PIR with owners. Closing thread here, but will post PIR link when available. :white_check_mark:
